tentang.subtitle: Active Numeracy with Information and Communication Technology
tentang.desc1: <boldPrimary>NUMATIK</boldPrimary> stands for <boldAccent>Nu</boldAccent>meracy <boldAccent>A</boldAccent>ctively with <boldAccent>T</boldAccent>echnology of <boldAccent>I</boldAccent>nformation and <boldAccent>K</boldAccent>nowledge — a mathematics education application specifically designed to bridge learning challenges in the digital era. Born from a passion for delivering learning that is not only informative, but also <boldAccent>meaningful and enjoyable</boldAccent>.
tentang.desc2: First launched in <boldPrimary>2026</boldPrimary>, Numatik was developed fully aligned with the <boldAccent>Merdeka Curriculum</boldAccent>. The app integrates a <boldSecondary>Deep Learning</boldSecondary> approach to ensure students don't merely memorize formulas, but understand concepts deeply, critically, and contextually.
tentang.desc3: Numatik is prepared to be a learning companion for all junior high school students around the world.
tentang.desktopDesc: Open <link>www.numatik.app</link> on your laptop or PC for a wider display and a better learning experience.
tentang.copyright: Eighth Edition · © 2026 NUMATIK. All rights reserved.

biografi.pesanSubtitle: 🌍 To All Students Around the World
biografi.pesanIsi: "Hello, amazing students around the world! I designed this app especially to make mathematics feel more approachable and friendly for all of you. Remember — no one is ever 'bad' at math; there are only those who haven't practiced enough yet. Happy exploring, and don't be afraid to make mistakes — because mistakes are how we truly learn!"

kelompokA2.paragraf1: My deepest gratitude goes to <orange>Kelompok A2 Guru Penggerak Angkatan 10</orange> — an extraordinary group that became the <amber>very first spark of inspiration</amber> behind the creation of NUMATIK.
kelompokA2.kutipan: "From one small group brimming with passion and purpose, an app was born — with the hope of inspiring thousands of learners."
kelompokA2.footer: THANK YOU, KELOMPOK A2 GURU PENGGERAK ANGKATAN 10

wandri.paragraf1: My sincerest gratitude goes to <cyan>Bapak Wandri, S.Pd., Gr.</cyan> — a colleague and mentor who, with wholehearted dedication, patience, and generosity, opened up a whole new world of knowledge in <accent>Information and Communication Technology</accent>.
wandri.paragraf2: He patiently taught me <cyan>coding</cyan> from scratch, and played a pivotal role in laying down and building the <accent>initial framework of NUMATIK</accent> — the very foundation that still supports this app today.
wandri.paragraf3: The knowledge, insights, and spirit he shared are the very pillars upon which <primary>NUMATIK</primary> was built.
wandri.kutipan: "A true teacher is not only one who imparts knowledge, but one who ignites the flame of passion within their students."
wandri.footer: THANK YOU SO MUCH, PAK WANDRI

donasi.subtitle: Support us to help the app grow
donasi.desc: Your support means a great deal to the development of NUMATIK, helping it become even more beneficial for students around the world. 💙
donasi.thankyou: Thank you so much for your support! 🙏
